adminUsers.UserPageEmpty.title: User not found
adminUsers.UserPageEmpty.description: The user you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been deleted.
adminUsers.SuperhostButton.removeSuperho: The badge disappears from every listing they own. Their listings update in the background, so it can take a moment on a large portfolio.
adminUsers.SuperhostButton.makeSuperhost: The badge appears on every listing they own, and on any listing they add later. Their listings update in the background, so it can take a moment on a large portfolio.
adminUsers.UserAccounts.title: Linked accounts
adminUsers.UserAccounts.description: Sign-in providers connected to this user.
adminUsers.UserActivity.title: Activity
adminUsers.UserActivity.description: Audit log entries scoped to this user. Newest first.
adminUsers.BanUserDialog.title: Ban {userEmail}
adminUsers.BanUserDialog.description: The user is signed out and cannot sign in again until unbanned. The optional reason is shown on next sign-in attempt.
adminUsers.ChangeRoleButton.demoteDescri: Are you sure you want to do this? The user will immediately lose admin privileges.
adminUsers.ChangeRoleButton.promoteDescr: Are you sure you want to do this? The user will gain full admin privileges, including the ability to ban and delete other accounts.
adminUsers.DeleteUserDialog.cannotDelete: Admins must be demoted to "user" before they can be deleted.
adminUsers.DeleteUserDialog.deleteDescri: This is permanent and cascades to sessions and accounts. Type the email below to confirm.
adminUsers.UnbanUserButton.label: Unban
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.title: Danger zone
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.description: Account-level actions. Changes here are audited and may be irreversible.
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.removeAdminDes: Remove admin privileges from this account.
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.grantAdminDesc: Grant admin privileges to this account.
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.unbanDescripti: Lift the ban so the user can sign in again.
adminUsers.UserDangerZone.banDescription: Sign the user out and prevent further sign-ins.
adminUsers.UserOverview.superhostDescrip: Superhost — the badge shows on every listing they own.
adminUsers.UserOverview.notSuperhostDesc: Not a superhost. Granting it shows the badge on all of their listings.
adminUsers.UserSessions.title: Active sessions
adminUsers.UserSessions.description: Devices currently signed in. Revoking signs the device out immediately.
